name: electron-codex-bridge
description: Connect Codex to an Electron app through local bridge tools, Chrome DevTools Protocol, and Electron best-practice guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and drive local Electron apps from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Adds MCP tools for Chrome DevTools Protocol targets and a local Electron main-process bridge so Codex can inspect windows, invoke explicit app handlers, evaluate renderer state in development, and capture BrowserWindow screenshots. The bridge skill automatically applies Electron + React best-practice guidance for secure contextBridge, typed IPC, packaging, signing, and Playwright testing workflows.
defaultPrompt: Audit my Electron app against best practices.
Invoke my Electron bridge health check.
